description: This file implements internal error handling for the UWP platform, including displaying error dialogs and managing error state for system platform errors related to YouTube connectivity issues.

classes.name: SbSystemPlatformErrorPrivate
classes.description: A class managing the display and lifecycle of system platform error dialogs on UWP, including error count management and callback invocation.

methods.name: SbSystemPlatformErrorPrivate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error dialog, displays it, and manages error count.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the dialog operation is still valid (i.e., the dialog is active).

methods.name: ClearAndDelete
methods.description: Cancels the dialog if active and deletes the object.

methods.name: MakeUICommand
methods.description: Creates a UICommand with a label and callback handler for user responses.
